project.name: UltimateDecompression
project.description: A Cocos Creator 2.4.13 water-ink themed fruit-merging puzzle game. Modular architecture with game (udGame), hinting (UdHinting), settings (udSetting), and toast message (udToastMessage) bundles, powered by a custom Ud* extension framework with Spine animation integration.

tour.title: App Entry
tour.description: UdAppEntry.ts — the main entry point for the game that initializes the application

tour.title: Core Framework
tour.description: Panel management, view components, toast messages, and utilities

tour.title: Extension Framework
tour.description: Lower-level systems: audio, resources, event signals, timers, object pooling, logging, animation

tour.title: Game Modules
tour.description: udGame (fruit merging), UdHinting (tutorial hints), udSetting, udToastMessage
